subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the Right to Work?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 41**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 41** of the Indian Constitution falls under the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) mentioned in Part IV of the Constitution.
 
• It directs the State to make effective provisions for securing the right to work, to education, and to public assistance in cases of unemployment, old age, sickness, and disablement.
 
• This article emphasizes the State's responsibility to promote social justice and economic welfare for its citizens.
 
• The implementation of Article 41 is subject to the economic capacity and development of the State.
 
• It reflects the vision of a welfare state as envisioned by the framers of the Constitution, ensuring the dignity of individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 39**

 
 
• It is part of the Directive Principles of State Policy and lays down certain principles of policy to be followed by the State.
 
• Article 39 emphasizes securing adequate means of livelihood, equitable distribution of resources, prevention of wealth concentration, equal pay for equal work for both men and women, protection of children, and ensuring a decent standard of living.
 
 
 
• **Article 42**
 
 
• It directs the State to make provisions for securing just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief.
 
• This article emphasizes the welfare of laborers and working conditions, ensuring social justice in workplaces.
 
 
 
• **Article 36**
 
 
• It defines the term "State" in the context of Part IV of the Constitution (Directive Principles of State Policy).
 
• As per Article 36, the State includes the Government and Parliament of India, the Government and Legislature of each State, and all local or other authorities within the territory of India or under the control of the Government of India.
